summary: Completed the knowledge-correction review for the audit's main account in a single validated record change, with no execution requested and nothing re-run. The parent question's account was rewritten as a successor that keeps its conclusion (violated, defect asserted), all six consequence classes, its ten-receipt evidence set, its controls and its counterevidence, and adds three things: an explicit review of knowledge e65d63f4057d4c5bbe8390ac06b30fce-knowledge-2 revision 2, noting that the account already reads the narrowed premise and that class (5) is itself the record of the boundary the correction introduces, so no claim depended on the unbounded following that was narrowed; the settlement, as far as the evidence allows, of the two variants the parent discriminator named, namely that peers receiving a forwarded Compaction::Snapshot recompute the bound and range per node and so are read to mirror the leader's loss rather than reach a different state, and that the trim path cannot raise a compacted index above a live replica's reported accepted index at all because its bound is the minimum recorded accepted index; and the answers to this investigation's two registered gaps, gap 838461385f784f74af057837ff488a66-gap-3 restated as resolved from the drift-bound receipt (one index per round over eight rounds, no repair by the leader change, the decided index frozen at 14 once the reports outran a write quorum, zero panics across eleven guarded stages) and gap ebbec352695d43beb398bb1b239cda41-gap-5 resolved by this review. Counterevidence and limitations were extended to separate what is executed from what is still derived, the new knowledge entry for the below-compacted re-synchronization was added to the account's uses, and the two child accounts affected by the same correction remain as reviewed in the previous turn. Incomplete and unexecuted: the forwarded-compaction peer variant, the direct-range-read and store-level-trim routes below a compacted index, the delivery of a forwarded Compaction::Snapshot to a NoSnapshot instance, and the one gap left open by design, the trim child's b26c13954e184cd2b9fdfda975aff136-gap-4, which carries its recorded partial progress.
